newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Monday closed down by 2.19 points on lower volume, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 602.67 from 604.86 on Friday.
Volume was 4.43 million dinars against 6.26 million dinars.
The main transaction was on Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie with 50,000 shares changing hands at 59.54 dinars each, the same level as last week.
BTEI bank was up 2.15 dinars to 25.31 dinars, and UBCI bank gained 1.56 dinars to 54 dinars.
Retail stores company Monoprix was down 1.38 dinars to 44.56 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
